fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers. Leave blank if purely decorative.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link (optional)
fields.description: When set, the image becomes a clickable link to this page or URL.

fields.name: linkTitle
fields.label: Link Title (optional)
fields.description: Accessible title shown as a tooltip on the link. Defaults to the alt text if blank.
